heading, Where business performance slips, unmanaged health issues are usually the cause, level 2
When people can’t access timely, specialist care, performance dips, absence rises and good people leave. These are the gaps standard benefits can’t fill and where employers feel the impact most.
Peppy exists to make expert-led healthcare simple, human and stigma-free, globally – because everyone deserves support that genuinely changes their life.
We connect employees around the world to specialist clinicians for proactive, ongoing and confidential support, removing the barriers that hold people back at work and at home.
heading, Expert care across six key health areas, level 2
Peppy connects your workforce to specialist clinicians, personalised care pathways and trusted resources.
Lifestyle healthcare underpins every service – nutrition, fitness and mental health support.
Peppy supports women, men, LGBTQ+ families, solo parents, non-binary people and those navigating long-ignored conditions.
Menstruation cycle concerns, pelvic pain, endometriosis, UTIs, PMS, PCOS, gynaecological issues and more. Peppy helps your people understand symptoms and get clear, specialist advice.

From low mood, stress and fatigue to sexual health, prostate & urology concerns, low testosterone, metabolic risk and more. Peppy gives the men in your workforce a private and confidential space to get expert guidance.

Fertility challenges often involve long waits, uncertainty and emotionally demanding appointments. Peppy provides specialist support, helping people feel informed at every step of the fertility journey.
end of heading, Pregnancy & Parenthood, level 3
From early pregnancy symptoms to birth recovery, infant feeding and returning to work. Peppy offers calm, practical support throughout pregnancy and early parenthood.
Symptoms such as brain fog, insomnia, anxiety and physical changes can significantly affect daily life. Peppy offers specialist support to help people understand and manage these life changes.

From ADHD and Autism to Dyslexia, Dyspraxia and beyond. Peppy connects your employees to specialist clinicians who can help them understand their condition, navigate diagnosis and get ongoing mental health support.
